title: 1963 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Rabbit
seo_title: 1963 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Rabbit (25 January – 12 February 1964)
description: 1963 is the Year of the Water Rabbit (Yin, Gui-mao), from 25 January 1963 to 12 February 1964. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1963.
lead: Born in 1963? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Rabbit, but check the date: the 1963 Water Rabbit year began on 25 January 1963. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1963: Year of the Water Rabbit, from 25 January 1963 to 12 February 1964.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1963 was the Year of the Rabbit. It began with Lunar New Year on 25 January 1963 and ended on 12 February 1964, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1963 ends in 3, which makes it a Water year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1963 is a Gui-mao year. The same Water Rabbit combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1903 before it and 2023 after it.
Lunar New Year 1963 fell on 25 January 1963. Anyone born from 1 January 1963 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Tiger; from 25 January 1963 on, the Rabbit.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Rabbit guide describes the sign like this: “Gentle, thoughtful, and diplomatic. Rabbits value harmony and are skilled at avoiding conflict.” The usual watch-out: “Can be overly cautious and avoid necessary confrontation.”

The Water element adds its own flavour. Water years bring intuition, adaptability, and calm wisdom. People of this element tend to be thoughtful, diplomatic, and perceptive. Read more in our Water element guide, or the full Year of the Rabbit page.
Careers often linked with the Rabbit: diplomacy, counseling, design, hospitality.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1963
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Rabbit's best matches are the Goat, Pig and Dog, and its clash sign is the Rooster, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Rabbit, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Rabbit, it shares the Goat's triangle (Rabbit, Goat and Pig), so 2027 is traditionally favourable. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Rabbit years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1951 (Metal Rabbit); 1975 (Wood Rabbit); 1987 (Fire Rabbit). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1963 is the Year of the Rabbit, a Yin Water Rabbit year (Gui-mao).
When does the 1963 Year of the Rabbit start and end?
It starts on 25 January 1963 and ends on 12 February 1964.
I was born in January 1963. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 25 January 1963, you are a Tiger; from 25 January 1963 on, a Rabbit.
Water. 1963 ends in 3, which belongs to Water, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Rabbit compatible with?
Traditionally the Goat, Pig and Dog. The Rabbit's clash sign is the Rooster.
